lines.zh: 我低头一路嗅，鼻尖拱着土。
lines.en: Head down, I sniff and root through soil.
Short legs trot and my belly sways.
I follow tree roots looking for wet earth.
Small hooves make the grass rustle loudly.

lines.zh: 别挡路，我闻到了好东西。
lines.en: Do not block the way, I smell something good.

lines.zh: 我走一段就停下来刨两下。
lines.en: I walk a bit, then dig a bit.
Deep leaves in the forest make soft steps.
Tail flicks and I turn into the bushes.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，像在找线索。
lines.en: I keep low, tracing something on the ground.
Grass grows taller than me; only my back shows.

lines.zh: 我走得不直，因为鼻子说了算。
lines.en: I walk crooked because my nose decides.
That patch of turf is mine now.

lines.zh: 我趴下，把肚子贴在土上。
lines.en: I lie down and press my belly to soil.
Grass scraps are still stuck in my snout.
I dug for ages and found nothing.
I grunt twice and shift position.

lines.zh: 树荫下凉快，我多待会儿。
lines.en: It is cool under the tree, I stay.

lines.zh: 耳朵转来转去，听着动静。
lines.en: My ears swivel, tracking every sound.

lines.zh: 我把嘴在树干上蹭干净。
lines.en: I wipe my snout clean on the trunk.
Freshly turned soil smells best to me.
A beetle is crawling over my back.
I roll once and flatten the grass.
The sun is warm and I nearly sleep.
Do not rush me, pigs rest too.
I nudge a stone with my nose.
I have turned this ground three times.

lines.zh: 鼻尖上有一层土，我不擦。
lines.en: There's dirt on my snout. I'll keep it.
I lean against the tree and rub twice.
Wind from over there. Let me sniff.
My hooves sink into soft dirt. Nice.

lines.zh: 我抬起沾泥的鼻子看你。
lines.en: I raise my muddy snout to look at you.
Small eyes watch you without blinking.
What is in your hand? Let me smell.

lines.zh: 别笑，野猪也是有脾气的。
lines.en: Do not laugh, wild boars have tempers.
I tilt my head and show one tusk.
You look at me; I sniff your boots.
My stare is fixed on your vegetables.
My gaze is short but very direct.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就往前一步。
lines.en: You step back and I step forward.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子抬起来嗅空气。
lines.en: I lift my nose and taste the air.
Your scent has carrots in it.

lines.zh: 看够了没，我要去挖土了。
lines.en: Seen enough? I am going digging.
Hit me and I squeal and run.
That blow shook the mud off me.
There is a red mark on my back now.
It hurts and I grunt, but I hold.
I turn around wanting to headbutt you.
You stepped on me, so I bite your boot.

lines.zh: 血滴在草叶上，很小一点。
lines.en: A little blood drips on the grass.
I dive into a bush and peek back out.

lines.zh: 别打了，我只是在找吃的。
lines.en: Stop hitting me, I was only foraging.
Dirt got in the wound, it stings more.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜一举，我立刻抬头。
lines.en: Raise a carrot and my head comes up.
I know the smell of beetroot anywhere.
I can bite apples, cores included.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃，我鼻子就跟着动。
lines.en: Wave it and my nose follows.
I trot over with my tail wagging.

lines.zh: 别拿土豆骗我，我闻得出。
lines.en: Do not cheat me with a potato, I can tell.
Breeding depends on these, I know.
One bite and I follow two steps.
I nudge your hand to hurry you.
Wheat works as well, for now.
Bumping me is like bumping a sack of potatoes.
My snout reaches your leg first.

lines.zh: 你踢开我，我哼一声又回来。
lines.en: You kick me off and I grunt back.

lines.zh: 我们挤在灌木口，谁都不让。
lines.en: We crowd the bush entrance, neither yields.

lines.zh: 我身上有泥，蹭你裤脚了。
lines.en: I am muddy; some rubbed on your trousers.

lines.zh: 这一下把我拱得歪了歪。
lines.en: The shove knocked me a little sideways.
Do not step on my tail, I squeal.
I bump you to sniff your bag.
Two pigs squeeze into one heap.
Keep your footing; I keep rooting.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜递过来，我就点头。
lines.en: Hand over a carrot and I agree.
Beetroot works, do not offer stones.

lines.zh: 我们拱同一块土，算认识。
lines.en: Rooting the same patch counts as meeting.
Piglets sniff everything from birth.
Do not stare, pigs get shy.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子贴了贴她的脖子。
lines.en: I pressed my nose against her neck.
This is better done behind a tree.
A litter of piglets makes noise.
An apple core counts as a gift.
Paired up, we turn soil faster.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的胡萝卜，我捡。
lines.en: A carrot on the ground, I take it.
The beetroot you dropped is mine now.
I pick it up and chew loudly.
Iron has no taste, I leave it.
Your bag leaked; I will help clean up.

lines.zh: 地上的马铃薯还带着土。
lines.en: The potato on the ground still has dirt.
I push leaves aside to find food.

lines.zh: 东西掉进泥里，我照样吃。
lines.en: Anything in the mud still gets eaten.
You pick up your sword; I pick vegetables.
An apple in my mouth slows me down.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我以为是胡萝卜。
lines.en: You raise your hand and I expect a carrot.

lines.zh: 我鼻子抽动，盯上你的包。
lines.en: My nose twitches and targets your bag.

lines.zh: 那块地有味道，我记住了。
lines.en: That ground has a smell I remember.

lines.zh: 我的小眼睛锁住了你的手。
lines.en: My small eyes lock onto your hand.

lines.zh: 你踩破草皮，我就过去了。
lines.en: You break the turf and I head over.

lines.zh: 目标很简单：能吃的东西。
lines.en: The target is simple: something edible.
I turn toward you and paw the dirt.

lines.zh: 别把菜举太高，我够不着。
lines.en: Do not hold it high, I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我选定你手里的那一根。
lines.en: I choose the one in your hand.
Once I smell it, I do not lose it.

lines.zh: 我小跑跟着你，鼻子不停。
lines.en: I trot after you, nose working constantly.

lines.zh: 你走快，我短腿也跟着快。
lines.en: You speed up and my short legs follow.
Turn into the forest and I turn too.
I root and chase at the same time.
Stop walking and I come to sniff.
I do not call out, my nose urges you.
The grass ahead is flattened by me.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在晃，很好追。
lines.en: The thing in your hand sways, easy to follow.
I cut to your side and block the path.
When it comes to vegetables, I persist.
I lower my head and ram your ankle.
My tusks are short but sharp enough.
I swing my head and shove you back.
That blow was me guarding my food.
Take my vegetables and I will hit you.
A hoof came down on your foot.
I charge, hit, and trot away.
Do not underestimate a twelve-health pig.
I clamp my teeth on your trouser leg.
After the hit I am still grunting.

lines.zh: 草原上多了一只拱土的猪。
lines.en: The plains gained one more rooting pig.

lines.zh: 我从林边走出来，带着泥。
lines.en: I step out of the treeline covered in mud.
Good turf here, I am staying.

lines.zh: 你听见灌木响，我就在那。
lines.en: You hear the bushes move; that is me.

lines.zh: 我生在树根旁边，闻着土长大。
lines.en: I grew up by a tree root, smelling earth.
I am the smallest of the litter.

lines.zh: 落叶底下钻出一只泥猪。
lines.en: A muddy pig crawls out from under leaves.

lines.zh: 别赶我，这地方本来就有猪。
lines.en: Do not shoo me, pigs live here too.
The sun just rose and I am already digging.

lines.zh: 我踩着露水，鼻子先落地。
lines.en: I walk on dew with my nose down first.

lines.zh: 森林和草原，我都待得住。
lines.en: Forest and plains both suit me fine.

lines.zh: 你回头，我正站在你菜地边。
lines.en: Turn around and I am at your garden.

lines.zh: 毛被燎了一下，我满地乱窜。
lines.en: My bristles singed and I ran in circles.

lines.zh: 我从土坡滚下去，一身泥。
lines.en: I rolled down the bank covered in mud.

lines.zh: 我扑腾两下，鼻子进了水。
lines.en: I paddled twice and water went up my nose.
The blast tossed me into the brambles.

lines.zh: 箭擦过背脊，带走一撮毛。
lines.en: The arrow grazed my spine and took fur.

lines.zh: 魔法的光让我鼻子发痒。
lines.en: Magic light made my nose itch.

lines.zh: 土翻遍了，一根菜也没有。
lines.en: I turned every clod and found no vegetable.
The thunder sent me into a hollow tree.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我还在闻泥土味。
lines.en: Falling through the void, I still smell soil.
